projectDescription: Turbo is an arcade-style game featuring collectible branded items (Turbo Soda, Turbo Chips) on wooden platform levels that players navigate to collect or avoid.
keyFeatures: Wooden platform levels with gap-based navigation
Collectible branded items (Turbo Soda, Turbo Chips)
Color-coded item glows indicating effect type (red = danger/penalty, green = reward)
publicApiSurface: Turbo Soda — red-glowing collectible on wooden platform
Turbo Chips — green-glowing collectible on wooden platform
Wooden platform — static level element players land and traverse
Platform gap — navigational hazard between platform segments
Bottom platform row — lowest level tier, currently empty/blank
